Initial release of Intelligence Brain — a new AI-native company intelligence engine.

- Introduces an 8-step metabolic pipeline for turning raw information into actionable intelligence within 24 hours.
- Enables cross-file inference and neural chain design for multi-source insights and robust agent communication.
- Implements WISDOM_GRAPH and ACTION_PIPELINE systems to generate and prioritize actionable tasks from organizational data.
- Features information classification and multi-model routing for security and cost optimization.
- Includes agent lifecycle management and auditability across all communication channels.
- Designed for OpenClaw agent runtime with support for scheduled execution, messaging, and multi-model integration.
